entries.title: Firstmate's sign-in card says what to do
entries.body: When Firstmate cannot reach its own model, its card now says so in plain words. It names the provider to sign in to again. For a custom connection, it says to press Edit and then Save in Settings → Intelligence to check it again. The card no longer shows sign-in commands or file paths from the app.

picture.alt: A provider needs sign in card from Firstmate saying it could not reach Grok, which needs you to sign in again
